https://www.bseindia.com/stockinfo/AnnPd.text: Anup Bagchi takes over as MD & CEO today; Sashidhar Jagdishan steps down on completing his tenure.
₹7,816 cr of 5-year NCDs allotted (≈1.9% of market cap) — a sizeable borrowing; listen for the use of funds on Friday's call.
Jio Platforms IPO has closed at ₹1,119 a share and the prospectus is filed — listing is the next value-unlock step.
Revenue +78% YoY and margin up to 3.1%, but treasury income still exceeds pre-tax profit — core earnings remain thin.
Going-out business moved within the group plus a ~₹156 cr Adonmo–Mygate share swap — housekeeping, immaterial at this size.
Wins Secretariat buildings in New Delhi and two Amaravati office towers; values are in the filing — tally against tonight's Q2 order inflow.
Limited notice to proceed on New Tashkent airport — pre-construction only; the full order books on final notice.
Tax tribunal rules largely in Maruti's favour for FY14–FY20 and FY22 — ≈₹13,000 cr positive impact, about 3.6% of market cap.
BBY Services India acquisition closed; management already flagged ~50 bps of H2 margin drag from acquisition accounting.
A large holder crossed a SAST disclosure threshold; the summary is blank — open the filing to see who traded and how much.
Takes CAE's 50% of the HATSOFF simulator JV for nil consideration — becomes wholly owned; no financial impact.
Executive Director (Finance) R Sriram retired 30 Sep with no successor named — watch who signs the Q2 accounts.
Buys the rest of Sproutlife for ₹645 cr, making it wholly owned — about 0.2% of market cap, a small bolt-on.
